item.title: San Jose Animal Care Center hit hard by fake viral FB post that used AI photo of shelter dog
item.description: San Jose Animal Care Center says they've received hundreds of calls in the last few days from people concerned about a sad-looking dog and the possibility of the animal being euthanized.

item.title: Trump administration's 'third country' deportation policy is unlawful, judge rules
item.description: The Trump administration's latest policy of deporting immigrants to "third countries" to which they have no ties is unlawful and must be set aside, a federal judge ruled Wednesday in a case that already reached the nation's highest court.

item.title: SF Chinese New Year Parade 2026: How to watch ABC7 Eyewitness News live coverage
item.description: Here's how to watch ABC7 Eyewitness News' broadcast of the largest Lunar New Year Celebration outside of Asia.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Fog and clouds overnight; warmer afternoons the next few days
item.description: A warming trend gets under way tomorrow and it continues Friday. Highs will run well above average ranging from the upper 60s to the mid 70s tomorrow with a mix of sun and clouds. Overnight, expect a combination of fog and clouds.

item.title: South Bay school holds domino run with hundreds of cereal boxes during donation drive
item.description: We were at the Stratford School's Beresford Square campus in Milpitas, where organizers conjured up an interesting way to celebrate all the donations: a cereal box domino run.

item.title: US child, teen obesity rates reach record high while adult trends appear to slow, CDC report finds
item.description: U.S. childhood and teen obesity rates have reached record-highs while adult obesity rates may be slowing, according to two new reports published early Wednesday by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

item.title: New California gambling regulations soon taking effect threaten San Jose card rooms: Here's how
item.description: On a typical weekday, Casino M8trix sees hundreds of card game players. On weekends, that number climbs into the thousands. New regulations set to take effect April 1 could significantly impact card rooms across California.

item.title: Met Gala reveals 2026 dress code: 'Fashion is Art'
item.description: The dress code for the 2026 gala is "Fashion is Art," according to Vogue.

item.title: 100 Burlingame businesses file lawsuit against gas station, operator over gas leak
item.description: First a gas leak, now a lawsuit. Burlingame businesses that went through an ordeal of road closures and power outages in January are now suing the companies they say are responsible.

item.title: Olympic champ Alysa Liu is back in the Bay! Here's where she visited, what Oakland has planned
item.description: Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu is back home after medaling in Italy. The gold medalist has been spotted at multiple spots around the Bay Area in the past 24 hours.
